_comment: What each lane owes, and when. Read by tools/lane-heartbeat.mjs, which the CoS desk runs every weekday. Written 2026-09-22 after the Sep 21 X Desk Watch filing went missing and nobody noticed until Mo asked a question that depended on it — the CoS desk's own condition (2) says a stalled loop must be visible in minutes, not days, and nothing was actually checking. NOTE the filings live in the claude.ai PROJECT, not the repo: these lanes hold no push credential by design, so a repo-side check can never see them. The heartbeat takes the Project's doc list and diffs it against what was due.

lanes.name: X Desk Watch (audits Grok Bot)
lanes.why: the only check on the vendor's feed; a silent day is a day nobody read what went public

lanes.name: Integrity Watch (instruments and claims)
lanes.why: catches a published number drifting from its source

lanes.name: Earnings Ideas Desk
lanes.why: the only lane whose job is finding money
